title: Malaysian national, cohort killed in Tawi-Tawi drug bust

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — An alleged Malaysian drug peddler carrying suspected shabu worth P13.4 million and his Filipino cohort were killed in a shootout with Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) operatives in Tawi-Tawi, an official confirmed on Monday. The buy-bust operation was conducted on Saturday afternoon, Nov. 15, in Barangay Tubig Mampallam, Bongao. Abraham Solon Kalim, PDEA Tawi-Tawi provincial officer, identified the fatalities as Malaysian Janimal Bin Hajad, alias “Ungod,” and Filipino Sansibar Amirul Amil.
